profile: Century Aluminum produces primary aluminum at smelters in the United States and Iceland, making standard-grade and value-added products for customers. Its portfolio also includes a majority interest in a Jamaican bauxite mining and alumina refining joint venture, plus a carbon anode facility in the Netherlands that supplies a company smelter. Product offerings include aluminum ingot, primary foundry alloy and low-carbon aluminum under its Natur-Al line.
